_help: Battery model settings (D2/D3). Values marked PROPOSED need confirmation in Experiment Design.

vehicle._source: Zeng et al. 2019 Eq. 6, fitted 23 Oct to decisions log 3.4 (hover 433 W, min 385 W at ~8 m/s, 507 W at 15, 1025 W at 23); radius, mass, k, delta from decisions log 3.3 / Experiment Design chat

battery._energy_note: Ben 23 Oct: sized so the optimal agent mission on a ~4 km set (14 m/s + 45 s hover per call; 64.8 Wh) ends with ~15 % left. Full drain ~10.5 min hovering. Supersedes the 128.3 Wh proposal.
battery._voltage_note: Assumed 6S x 3.7 V. With voltage_model 'constant' it only affects the logged current, not the %.

gate._note: Ben 23 Oct: warning at 15 %. Below 15 % the battery drains 1 % per 100 m flown (reserve = 1.5 km); hovering/slow flight (< 2 m/s) keeps draining at the model rate. No forced return. At 0 %: land in place, block ends (crash/damage once G-series exists).
